slippage_tolerance_percent.meaning: slippage protection percentage Alice sets on her submitted Router swap transaction

eth_price_at_submission.meaning: ETH price in USD at the time Alice submits her swap transaction

eth_price_before_inclusion.meaning: ETH price in USD after the transaction has sat in the mempool and before it is included

tx_delayed_in_mempool.meaning: Alice's swap transaction sat in the mempool for hours due to network congestion

value_received_far_less_than_intended.meaning: the user receives far less value than intended (potential outcome of executing the stale transaction at the changed price)

assumptions: Alice's swap transaction is a Router swap submitted with 1% slippage protection at ETH = $2000.
The transaction remains pending in the mempool for hours before inclusion.
ETH price falls to $1500 before inclusion, so the stale transaction executes at a materially worse price than at submission.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric deadline/expiry bound; the missing deadline is a qualitative absence, so the temporal-validity condition is expressed only via the mempool-delay and price-change facts.
Report does not distinguish whether the $1500 execution is an observed transaction or a hypothetical scenario, and does not state who includes the delayed transaction.

limitations: The selected impact is potential; the relation only forbids the far-less-value outcome under the stated delayed-and-price-changed scenario and does not assert it is inevitable.
Slippage tolerance is bound to the report literal 1 percent; the absolute price-level intent (intent_slippage_bounds_absolute_price) is not formalized in this pass.

Other impacts (mev_delayed_transactions_worst_prices, every_swap_user_exposed, increased_exposure_adverse_price_movements, alice_receives_less_value) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
